ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Fonts [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Fonts[/h1] [i]Real typefaces on ScriptedScreens consoles. Client-side only.[/i]
Use the game's own fonts and any .ttf or .otf file by name in a ScriptedScreens label, with the standard tag: [code]<font="Barlow Condensed">TANK 3 84%[/code]. There is nothing to call from Lua; the tag simply works.
[h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] Ships the Barlow and Barlow Condensed families, every weight with italics [*] Add your own fonts: drop files into [b]Documents/My Games/Stationeers/fonts[/b] [*] Names come from the font itself: Barlow-Bold.ttf is <font="Barlow Bold"> [*] An on/off switch per font file in the mod settings [*] Dashes, maths symbols, arrows and box drawing included when the font has them [/list]
[h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds four examples that run on paste, a quick start (QUICKSTART.md), a guide (README.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]on GitHub[/url]. Every available font name is written to BepInEx/LogOutput.log. With StationeersLua's MCP server on, AI editors can read the same docs and the live font list.
[h2]What's new in 0.2.0[/h2] [list] [*] Load your own .ttf and .otf files, with a switch for each [*] Bundled Barlow and Barlow Condensed [*] Examples, a quick start and docs for AI editors [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url].
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required; it brings StationeersLua) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts[/url] (MIT; bundled fonts SIL OFL 1.1).
